Shimmer Wireless Charger with Clock – 15W Fast Wireless Charging & Smart Bedside Companion

Upgrade your daily charging experience with the Shimmer Wireless Charger with Clock, a sleek and multifunctional solution designed for modern homes and workspaces. Combining 15W fast wireless charging, a built-in LED clock, and multiple USB ports, this advanced charging station delivers convenience, efficiency, and style in one compact unit. Whether placed on a bedside table, office desk, or study corner, this charger keeps your devices powered while enhancing your space with a clean, modern aesthetic.

Built with universal Qi compatibility, the Shimmer wireless charging station works seamlessly with a wide range of smartphones, including Android and iOS devices that support wireless charging. The intelligent charging technology automatically detects the optimal power requirement, ensuring safe and stable charging without overheating or overloading. Its compact and space-saving design makes it ideal for users who value functionality without clutter.

The integrated LED clock adds an extra layer of practicality, making the Shimmer Wireless Charger a perfect bedside companion. The clear digital display allows you to check the time at a glance, day or night, while charging your phone wirelessly. This dual-purpose design reduces the need for multiple devices, helping you maintain a tidy and organized environment.

Key Features

  • 15W Fast Wireless Charging for quick and efficient power delivery
  • Built-in LED Clock with clear and easy-to-read display
  • Multiple USB Ports for charging additional devices simultaneously
  • Universal Qi Compatibility supports a wide range of smartphones
  • Sleek & Modern Design that complements contemporary interiors
  • Compact & Space-Saving structure ideal for bedside tables and desks
  • Advanced Safety Protection Features including over-voltage and temperature control

Designed for safety and durability, the Shimmer includes built-in safety protection features such as over-current protection, short-circuit prevention, and temperature regulation. These features ensure your devices remain protected during charging, making it a reliable solution for everyday use at home or in the office.

The sleek and modern design of this dock makes it more than just a utility—it’s a statement accessory. Its minimalistic finish blends effortlessly with modern décor, making it suitable for bedrooms, corporate offices, hotels, and coworking spaces. The compact footprint ensures maximum usability without occupying unnecessary space.

Looking for a thoughtful and practical gifting option? The Shimmer with is a great gift idea for corporate gifting, festive occasions, employee rewards, and personal celebrations. Its universal appeal, premium build quality, and daily usability make it a smart choice for tech-savvy users and professionals alike.

As a multifunctional charging solution, this device serves as a in one. Whether you need a reliable charging station for your smartphone or a stylish bedside accessory, the Shimmer delivers performance, safety, and elegance in one powerful package.

Choose the Shimmer to experience fast wireless charging, smart time display, and modern convenience—all designed to simplify your daily routine while keeping your devices powered and protected.
